theorems.name: Submission.mono833_exp_weighted_density_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (ρ₀ Λ : ℝ), 0 < ρ₀ → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ)) * P ρ) (Ioo 0 ρ₀) → P (ρ₀ / 2) ≠ ∞ → ∃ θ : ℝ≥0∞, Tendsto P (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 θ) ∧ θ ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ < ρ₀ → θ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * σ)) * P σ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
